title: 去药房取处方药，怎么说？
summary: 医生开了处方，去 CVS 或 Walgreens 的药房取药：报名字、问用法、问副作用。

featuredPhrase.en: I'm here to pick up my prescription.

phrases.en: I'm here to pick up my prescription.
I need a refill on my prescription.
What are the side effects of this medicine?
How should I take this medicine?
Do I need to avoid any foods?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Hi, I'm here to pick up my prescription.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我是来取处方药的。

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.en: Your name and date of birth, please?
dialogue.zh: 请报一下姓名和出生日期？

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.zh: Li Wei，1990 年 1 月 5 日。

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.en: Here you go. Take one pill twice a day with food.
dialogue.zh: 给你，一天两次，一次一片，随餐吃。

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: What are the side effects of this medicine?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.en: It may make you drowsy. Don't drive after taking it.
dialogue.zh: 可能会嗜睡，吃完别开车。

seoTitle: 美国药房取药英语怎么说？拿处方药对话
seoDescription: 在美国药房取处方药的完整英语说法：报名字、问吃法、问副作用。本文附真实对话，取药一次搞定。
